macros.name: LCtoSC
macros.doc: The macro \Lctosc{ arg} is for a local change of arg and \LCtoSC+ and \LCtoSC- for a global change of capitals to small caps.

macros.name: Lctosmcp
macros.doc: The macro \Lctosmcp{ arg} is for a local change of arg and \LCtoSMCP+ and \LCtoSMCP- for a global change of capitals to small caps.

macros.name: LCtoSMCP
macros.doc: The macro \Lctosmcp{ arg} is for a local change of arg and \LCtoSMCP+ and \LCtoSMCP- for a global change of capitals to small caps.

macros.name: Lliga
macros.doc: The macros \Lliga{ arg} (standard ligatures), \Lhlig{ arg} (historical ligatures), \Ldlig{ arg} (discretionary ligatures) are for a local change of arg and \LLIGA+ /\LLIGA- , \LHLIG+ /\LHLIG- , and \LDLIG+ /\LDIG- for a global change of capitals to small caps relative to the current group.

macros.name: Lsalt
macros.doc: The macro \Lsalt{ arg} is for a local change of arg and \LSALT+ and \LSALT- for the alternate characters.
